'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**[[2021 evacuation from Afghanistan]]
***[[Operation Allies Refuge]]
****[[White House Chief of Staff]] [[Ron Klain]] says that around 100 [[Americans]] remain in [[Afghanistan]] following the [[Withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan (2020–2021)|August 31 withdrawal]] deadline. He also says that the [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] will still try to rescue them. [https://www.politico.com/news/2021/09/05/americans-left-afghanistan-klain-509730 (Politico)]
**[[Panjshir conflict]]
***[[Taliban]] spokesperson [[Bilal Karimi]] says that [[Taliban Security Force|Taliban forces]] have entered [[Bazarak]], the capital of [[Panjshir Province]], after gaining more territory in the surrounding areas. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taliban-say-they-have-entered-capital-holdout-afghan-region-2021-09-05/ (Reuters)]
***[[Mohammad Fahim Dashty]], a chief and spokesperson of the [[National Resistance Front of Afghanistan]], is killed by the Taliban during a fight. [https://www.theweek.in/news/world/2021/09/06/fahim-dashti-survived-the-lion-of-panjshir-assassination-now-under-taliban-fire-he-is-killed.html (The Week)]
*[[2021 Guinean coup d'état]]
**Heavy gunfire is heard in [[Conakry]], [[Guinea]], as soldiers seal off and block the main bridge connecting to the [[Kaloum]] neighborhood, which houses the [[Presidential Palace (Guinea)|Presidential Palace]]. [[President of Guinea|President]] [[Alpha Condé]] is arrested and taken away by [[Republic of Guinea Armed Forces|special forces soldiers]] but appears to be unharmed. Three soldiers are reportedly killed. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-58453778 (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/heavy-gunfire-heard-guinea-capital-conakry-reuters-witness-2021-09-05/ (Reuters)] [https://www.europapress.es/internacional/noticia-militares-golpistas-detienen-presidente-guinea-ordenan-disolver-instituciones-20210905155127.html (Europa Press)][https://www.economist.com/middle-east-and-africa/2021/09/05/alpha-conde-the-president-of-guinea-is-apparently-ousted-in-a-coup (The Economist)]
**The [[Republic of Guinea Armed Forces|military]] seizes [[Radio Télévision Guinéenne|state television]] and announces on air that the [[Government of Guinea|government]] has been dissolved and that all [[land border]]s are closed. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/guinean-army-colonel-state-television-government-dissolved-land-79845322 (ABC News)]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**Three soldiers are killed and 15 more are injured as a [[suicide bombing|suicide bomber]] blows himself up at a [[Security checkpoint|checkpoint]] in [[Quetta]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. The [[Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan]] claims responsibility for the attack. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/5/several-troops-killed-in-southwestern-pakistan-suicide-bombing (Al Jazeera)]
*[[ISIL insurgency in Iraq (2017–present)|ISIL insurgency in Iraq]]
**Twelve police officers are killed and three others are wounded as [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] militants open fire and bomb a [[security checkpoint]] in [[Kirkuk]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/9/5/isil-attack-kills-at-least-13-iraqi-police-security-medics (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Mapuche conflict]]
**Violence intensifies during a four-day clash in the [[Mapuche]] [[Araucanía Region]] in [[Chile]], between [[Chilean Army|Chilean forces]] and the [[Mapuche people]]. A presidential delegate has called on [[Congress of Chile|the Congress]] to speed the arrest and prosecution of what he called "terrorists". [https://en.mercopress.com/2021/09/05/more-arson-and-terrorist-attacks-in-mapuche-claimed-territory-south-of-chile (MercoPress)]
*A knifeman stabs and seriously wounds two women in [[Berlin]], [[Germany]]. Authorities are investigating if the attacker was motivated by [[Islamic extremism]]. He targeted the first victim claiming that "he didn't like that a woman was working". [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/man-berlin-attacks-woman-allegedly-worked-79847027 (ABC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**The death toll from [[Hurricane Ida]] in the [[Northeastern United States]] increases to 50. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/09/05/hurricane-ida-death-toll-in-the-us-northeast-rises-to-at-least-50-victims.html (CNBC)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cambodia]]
****The number of population who have received their first dose of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] in [[Cambodia]] surpasses 70%. [https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/aseanplus-news/2021/09/05/cambodia-reaches-the-70-covid-19-vaccination-milestone (''The Star'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka]]
****[[Sri Lanka]] surpasses 10,000 deaths from [[COVID-19]]. [http://www.adaderana.lk/news/76693/sri-lankas-covid-death-toll-hits-10000 (Adaderana)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Vietnam]]
****The [[Ministry of Health (Vietnam)|Vietnamese health ministry]] announces that [[Hanoi]], [[Ho Chi Minh City]], [[Bình Dương Province|Bình Dương]], [[Dong Nai Province|Dong Nai]] and [[Long An Province|Long An]] provinces must vaccinate all of their adult residents with at least one dose of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] by September 15. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/vietnam-sets-sep-15-deadline-vaccinate-adults-hanoi-ho-chi-minh-city-2157901 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] surpasses four million cases of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/germany-passes-4m-covid-19-cases-mark-since-start-of-pandemic (''Daily Sabah'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] surpasses seven million cases of COVID-19, becoming the fourth country to do so after the [[United States]], [[India]], and [[Brazil]]. [https://www.kyivpost.com/eastern-europe/reuters-russias-coronavirus-cases-surpass-7-million-mark.html (''Kyiv Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Peru]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Peru]]
***[[Peru]] begins vaccinations for people aged 30 in [[Lima]], [[Callao]], and the [[Ica Region]]. [https://andina.pe/ingles/noticia-peru-covid19-vaccination-of-30yearolds-begins-today-860405.aspx (Andina)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2021 Montenegrin episcopal ordination protests]]
**[[Law enforcement in Montenegro|Police]] fire [[tear gas]] and remove barricades in [[Cetinje]], [[Montenegro]], as [[Anti-Serb sentiment|anti-Serb]] [[Montenegrin nationalism|Montenegrin nationalist]] protesters attempted to impede the enthronement of [[Joanikije II, Metropolitan of Montenegro|Joanikije II]] to the [[Metropolitanate of Montenegro and the Littoral]] of the [[Serbian Orthodox Church]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/montenegro-tensions-erupt-over-serbian-church-leaders/a-59087415 (Deutsche Welle)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 São Toméan presidential election]]
**[[Carlos Vila Nova]], from the [[Independent Democratic Action]], wins the second round of the presidential election. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/sao-tome-opposition-leader-vila-nova-wins-presidential-runoff-2021-09-06/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2020 Summer Paralympics]]
**[[Afghanistan at the 2020 Summer Paralympics]]
***[[Afghanistan at the Paralympics|Afghanistan athletes]] [[Zakia Khudadadi]] and [[Hossain Rasouli]] carry the [[Flag of Afghanistan|Afghan flag]] during the [[2020 Summer Paralympics closing ceremony|closing ceremony]] of the [[2020 Summer Paralympics]] after being unable to attend the [[2020 Summer Paralympics opening ceremony|opening ceremony]] due to the [[Withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan (2020–2021)|withdrawal of American troops]] from the country. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/olympics/2021/09/05/afghanistan-paralympics-flag-bearers/ (''The Washington Post'')]
**The [[2020 Summer Paralympics closing ceremony|closing ceremony]] for the Summer Paralympics is held. [[China at the 2020 Summer Paralympics|China leads the Olympic medal count]] with 207 medals, including 96 gold medals. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/09/05/sport/tokyo-paralympics-closing-ceremony-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2022 FIFA World Cup qualification (CONMEBOL)|2022 FIFA World Cup qualification]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on association football]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
**The qualification match between [[Brazil national football team|Brazil]] and [[Argentina national football team|Argentina]] at the [[Arena Corinthians]] in [[São Paulo]] is suspended after officials from the [[Brazilian Health Regulatory Agency]] entered the pitch and attempted to deport four Argentine players whom they allege to have violated pandemic-related [[Isolation (health care)|self-isolation]] guidelines. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/09/05/sports/soccer/brazil-argentina-suspended.html (''The New York Times'')]
